SELECT AccountNo, CustomerID, AccountType, Balance
FROM Account
WHERE Status = 'Active'
ORDER BY Balance DESC, AccountNo;

SELECT AccountNo, CustomerID, AccountType, Balance
FROM Account
WHERE Status = 'Active'
ORDER BY Balance DESC, AccountNo;

SELECT AccountNo, Balance
FROM Account
WHERE Balance BETWEEN 50000 AND 250000
ORDER BY Balance, AccountNo;

SELECT CustomerID, FirstName, LastName, KYC_Status
FROM Customer
WHERE KYC_Status IN ('Approved', 'Pending') AND FirstName LIKE 'A%'
ORDER BY FirstName, CustomerID;

SELECT TransactionID, AccountNo, Amount, Remarks
FROM Transaction_History
WHERE Remarks IS NULL
ORDER BY TransactionID;

SELECT KYC_Status, COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM Customer
GROUP BY KYC_Status
ORDER BY KYC_Status NULLS LAST;

SELECT AccountType, SUM(Balance) AS total_balance
FROM Account
GROUP BY AccountType
ORDER BY AccountType;

SELECT Role, ROUND(AVG(Salary), 2) AS average_salary,
       MIN(Salary) AS minimum_salary, MAX(Salary) AS maximum_salary
FROM Employee
GROUP BY Role
ORDER BY Role;

SELECT BranchID, COUNT(*) AS active_account_count,
       SUM(Balance) AS active_balance
FROM Account
WHERE Status = 'Active'
GROUP BY BranchID
HAVING SUM(Balance) >= 100000
ORDER BY active_balance DESC, BranchID;

SELECT PaymentMode, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
       SUM(Amount) AS gross_amount, ROUND(AVG(Amount), 2) AS average_amount
FROM Transaction_History
GROUP BY PaymentMode
ORDER BY gross_amount DESC, PaymentMode;

SELECT a.AccountNo, c.FirstName, c.LastName, b.BranchName, a.Balance
FROM Account a
INNER JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerID = a.CustomerID
INNER JOIN Branch b ON b.BranchID = a.BranchID
ORDER BY a.AccountNo;

SELECT c.CustomerID, c.FirstName, l.LoanID, l.LoanType, l.Status
FROM Customer c
LEFT JOIN Loan l ON l.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
ORDER BY c.CustomerID, l.LoanID;

SELECT b.BranchID, b.BranchName, l.LoanID, l.OutstandingBalance
FROM Loan l
RIGHT JOIN Branch b ON b.BranchID = l.BranchID
ORDER BY b.BranchID, l.LoanID;

SELECT d.IFSC_Code AS directory_ifsc, d.BankName,
       b.IFSC_Code AS branch_ifsc, b.BranchName
FROM Bank_Directory d
FULL OUTER JOIN Branch b ON b.IFSC_Code = d.IFSC_Code
ORDER BY COALESCE(d.IFSC_Code, b.IFSC_Code);

SELECT a.CustomerID, a.AccountNo AS first_account, a.AccountType AS first_type,
       other.AccountNo AS second_account, other.AccountType AS second_type
FROM Account a
JOIN Account other ON other.CustomerID = a.CustomerID
                 AND a.AccountNo < other.AccountNo
ORDER BY a.CustomerID, a.AccountNo, other.AccountNo;

SELECT b.BranchID, b.BranchName, product.AccountType,
       COUNT(a.AccountNo) AS account_count
FROM Branch b
CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT AccountType FROM Account) product
LEFT JOIN Account a ON a.BranchID = b.BranchID
                   AND a.AccountType = product.AccountType
GROUP BY b.BranchID, b.BranchName, product.AccountType
ORDER BY b.BranchID, product.AccountType;

SELECT AccountNo, Balance,
       (SELECT ROUND(AVG(Balance), 2) FROM Account) AS bank_average_balance
FROM Account
ORDER BY Balance DESC, AccountNo;

SELECT CustomerID, FirstName, LastName
FROM Customer
WHERE CustomerID = (
    SELECT CustomerID FROM Account
    WHERE AccountType = 'Savings'
    ORDER BY Balance DESC, AccountNo
    LIMIT 1
)
ORDER BY CustomerID;

SELECT LoanID, CustomerID, LoanType, PrincipalAmount
FROM Loan
WHERE CustomerID IN (SELECT CustomerID FROM Account WHERE Status = 'Active')
  AND PrincipalAmount > ANY (SELECT PrincipalAmount FROM Loan WHERE LoanType = 'Personal')
  AND PrincipalAmount >= ALL (SELECT PrincipalAmount FROM Loan WHERE LoanType = 'Auto')
ORDER BY PrincipalAmount DESC, LoanID;

SELECT c.CustomerID, c.FirstName, c.LastName
FROM Customer c
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM Account a
    WHERE a.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
      AND a.Balance > (SELECT AVG(peer.Balance) FROM Account peer
                       WHERE peer.BranchID = a.BranchID)
)
ORDER BY c.CustomerID;

SELECT c.CustomerID, c.FirstName, c.LastName
FROM Customer c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Loan l WHERE l.CustomerID = c.CustomerID)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Fixed_Deposit f WHERE f.CustomerID = c.CustomerID)
ORDER BY c.CustomerID;

WITH narratives AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT Remarks FROM Transaction_History WHERE Remarks IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT '1. Unsafe NOT IN (NULL poisoned)' AS demonstration,
       COUNT(*) AS matching_narratives
FROM narratives
WHERE Remarks NOT IN (
    SELECT Remarks FROM Transaction_History WHERE TransactionType = 'Withdrawal'
)
UNION ALL
SELECT '2. Corrected NOT IN (NULL filtered)', COUNT(*)
FROM narratives
WHERE Remarks NOT IN (
    SELECT Remarks FROM Transaction_History
    WHERE TransactionType = 'Withdrawal' AND Remarks IS NOT NULL
)
ORDER BY demonstration;

SELECT CustomerID FROM Account WHERE AccountType = 'Savings'
UNION
SELECT CustomerID FROM Loan
ORDER BY CustomerID;

SELECT CustomerID, 'Account' AS product, AccountNo AS product_id FROM Account
UNION ALL
SELECT CustomerID, 'Fixed Deposit', FD_ID FROM Fixed_Deposit
ORDER BY CustomerID, product, product_id;

SELECT CustomerID FROM Account WHERE AccountType = 'Savings'
INTERSECT
SELECT CustomerID FROM Account WHERE AccountType = 'Current'
ORDER BY CustomerID;

SELECT CustomerID FROM Account
EXCEPT
SELECT CustomerID FROM Loan
ORDER BY CustomerID;

SELECT AccountNo, Balance,
       CASE WHEN Balance >= 250000 THEN 'High'
            WHEN Balance >= 50000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS balance_band,
       ROUND(Balance * InterestRate / 1200.0, 2) AS estimated_monthly_interest
FROM Account
ORDER BY AccountNo;

SELECT a.AccountNo, a.Balance,
       COALESCE(SUM(t.Amount) FILTER (WHERE t.TransactionType = 'Withdrawal'), 0)
           AS recorded_withdrawals,
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(t.Amount)
           FILTER (WHERE t.TransactionType = 'Withdrawal'), 0)
           / NULLIF(a.Balance, 0), 2) AS withdrawals_to_current_balance_pct
FROM Account a
LEFT JOIN Transaction_History t ON t.AccountNo = a.AccountNo
GROUP BY a.AccountNo, a.Balance
ORDER BY a.AccountNo;

SELECT a.AccountNo, UPPER(CONCAT(c.FirstName, ' ', c.LastName)) AS display_name,
       a.OpeningDate,
       AGE(CURRENT_DATE::timestamp, a.OpeningDate::timestamp) AS account_tenure,
       EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(CURRENT_DATE::timestamp, a.OpeningDate::timestamp))
           AS completed_years
FROM Account a
JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerID = a.CustomerID
ORDER BY a.AccountNo;

SELECT AccountNo, BranchID, Balance,
       RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY BranchID ORDER BY Balance DESC) AS balance_rank,
       DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY BranchID ORDER BY Balance DESC) AS dense_balance_rank
FROM Account
ORDER BY BranchID, balance_rank, AccountNo;

SELECT TransactionID, AccountNo, TransactionDate, Amount,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY AccountNo
           ORDER BY TransactionDate DESC NULLS LAST, TransactionID DESC) AS recency_number
FROM Transaction_History
ORDER BY AccountNo, recency_number;

SELECT TransactionID, AccountNo, TransactionDate, Amount,
       SUM(Amount) OVER (PARTITION BY AccountNo
           ORDER BY TransactionDate NULLS LAST, TransactionID
           ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_gross_volume
FROM Transaction_History
ORDER BY AccountNo, TransactionDate NULLS LAST, TransactionID;

SELECT TransactionID, AccountNo, TransactionDate, Amount,
       LAG(Amount) OVER account_events AS previous_amount,
       LEAD(TransactionDate) OVER account_events AS next_transaction_date
FROM Transaction_History
WINDOW account_events AS (PARTITION BY AccountNo
                         ORDER BY TransactionDate NULLS LAST, TransactionID)
ORDER BY AccountNo, TransactionDate NULLS LAST, TransactionID;

SELECT l.LoanID, c.CustomerID, CONCAT(c.FirstName, ' ', c.LastName) AS borrower,
       b.BranchName, l.OutstandingBalance AS defaulted_outstanding,
       COUNT(r.PaymentID) FILTER (WHERE r.PaymentStatus = 'Failed') AS failed_attempts,
       MAX(r.PaymentDate) FILTER (WHERE r.PaymentStatus = 'Success') AS last_successful_payment
FROM Loan l
JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerID = l.CustomerID
JOIN Branch b ON b.BranchID = l.BranchID
LEFT JOIN Loan_Repayment r ON r.LoanID = l.LoanID
WHERE l.Status = 'Defaulted'
GROUP BY l.LoanID, c.CustomerID, c.FirstName, c.LastName, b.BranchID, b.BranchName
ORDER BY l.OutstandingBalance DESC, l.LoanID;

WITH activity AS (
    SELECT b.BranchID, b.BranchName, p.City,
           COUNT(t.TransactionID) AS transaction_count,
           COALESCE(SUM(t.Amount), 0) AS gross_volume
    FROM Branch b
    JOIN Postal_Directory p ON p.Pincode = b.Pincode
    LEFT JOIN Account a ON a.BranchID = b.BranchID
    LEFT JOIN Transaction_History t ON t.AccountNo = a.AccountNo
        AND t.TransactionDate >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '365 days'
        AND t.TransactionDate <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    GROUP BY b.BranchID, b.BranchName, p.City
), ranked AS (
    SELECT activity.*, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY transaction_count DESC) AS activity_rank
    FROM activity
)
SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE activity_rank <= 3
ORDER BY activity_rank, gross_volume DESC, BranchID;

WITH deposits AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, COUNT(*) AS active_fd_count, SUM(Amount) AS fd_principal
    FROM Fixed_Deposit WHERE Status = 'Active' GROUP BY CustomerID
), accounts AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Balance) AS active_account_balance
    FROM Account WHERE Status = 'Active' GROUP BY CustomerID
)
SELECT c.CustomerID, CONCAT(c.FirstName, ' ', c.LastName) AS customer_name,
       c.Phone, d.active_fd_count, d.fd_principal, a.active_account_balance
FROM Customer c
JOIN deposits d ON d.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
JOIN accounts a ON a.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.KYC_Status = 'Approved'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Loan l WHERE l.CustomerID = c.CustomerID)
ORDER BY d.fd_principal DESC, c.CustomerID;

WITH daily AS (
    SELECT t.TransactionDate::date AS transaction_day,
           COUNT(*) AS event_count, COUNT(DISTINCT b.BranchID) AS contributing_branches,
           SUM(t.Amount) AS gross_volume
    FROM Transaction_History t
    JOIN Account a ON a.AccountNo = t.AccountNo
    JOIN Branch b ON b.BranchID = a.BranchID
    WHERE t.TransactionDate IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY t.TransactionDate::date
), ranked AS (
    SELECT daily.*, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY gross_volume DESC) AS volume_rank
    FROM daily
)
SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE volume_rank <= 3
ORDER BY volume_rank, transaction_day;

WITH balances AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Balance) AS account_balance
    FROM Account WHERE Status IN ('Active', 'Dormant', 'Frozen') GROUP BY CustomerID
), deposits AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Amount) AS fd_principal
    FROM Fixed_Deposit WHERE Status = 'Active' GROUP BY CustomerID
), debt AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, SUM(OutstandingBalance) AS loan_outstanding
    FROM Loan WHERE Status IN ('Approved', 'Active', 'Defaulted') GROUP BY CustomerID
)
SELECT c.CustomerID, CONCAT(c.FirstName, ' ', c.LastName) AS customer_name,
       COALESCE(a.account_balance, 0) AS account_balance,
       COALESCE(f.fd_principal, 0) AS active_fd_principal,
       COALESCE(l.loan_outstanding, 0) AS loan_outstanding,
       COALESCE(a.account_balance, 0) + COALESCE(f.fd_principal, 0)
           - COALESCE(l.loan_outstanding, 0) AS indicative_net_position
FROM Customer c
LEFT JOIN balances a ON a.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
LEFT JOIN deposits f ON f.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
LEFT JOIN debt l ON l.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
ORDER BY indicative_net_position DESC, c.CustomerID;

WITH contact_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.CustomerID, a.AccountNo, b.BranchName,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.CustomerID
               ORDER BY a.OpeningDate, a.AccountNo) AS preference
    FROM Account a
    JOIN Branch b ON b.BranchID = a.BranchID
    WHERE a.Status = 'Active'
)
SELECT f.FD_ID, c.CustomerID, CONCAT(c.FirstName, ' ', c.LastName) AS customer_name,
       c.Phone, f.EndDate, CURRENT_DATE - f.EndDate AS days_since_maturity,
       f.MaturityAmount, a.AccountNo AS suggested_contact_account,
       a.BranchName AS suggested_contact_branch
FROM Fixed_Deposit f
JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerID = f.CustomerID
LEFT JOIN contact_accounts a ON a.CustomerID = c.CustomerID AND a.preference = 1
WHERE f.Status = 'Active' AND f.EndDate <= CURRENT_DATE
ORDER BY f.EndDate, f.FD_ID;

WITH staffing AS (
    SELECT BranchID, COUNT(*) AS staff_count, SUM(Salary) AS monthly_payroll
    FROM Employee GROUP BY BranchID
), holdings AS (
    SELECT BranchID, COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerID) AS customer_count,
           SUM(Balance) AS deposit_balance
    FROM Account WHERE Status IN ('Active', 'Dormant', 'Frozen') GROUP BY BranchID
)
SELECT b.BranchID, b.BranchName, p.City,
       COALESCE(s.staff_count, 0) AS staff_count,
       COALESCE(s.monthly_payroll, 0) AS monthly_payroll,
       COALESCE(h.deposit_balance, 0) AS deposit_balance,
       ROUND(COALESCE(h.customer_count, 0)::numeric / NULLIF(s.staff_count, 0), 2)
           AS customers_per_employee,
       ROUND(COALESCE(h.deposit_balance, 0) / NULLIF(s.monthly_payroll, 0), 2)
           AS balance_to_monthly_payroll_ratio
FROM Branch b
JOIN Postal_Directory p ON p.Pincode = b.Pincode
LEFT JOIN staffing s ON s.BranchID = b.BranchID
LEFT JOIN holdings h ON h.BranchID = b.BranchID
ORDER BY customers_per_employee DESC NULLS LAST, b.BranchID;

WITH exposure AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerID, CONCAT(c.FirstName, ' ', c.LastName) AS customer_name,
           d.BankName, COUNT(*) AS beneficiary_count,
           SUM(b.MaxTransferLimit) AS configured_limit_sum
    FROM Customer c
    JOIN Beneficiary b ON b.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    JOIN Bank_Directory d ON d.IFSC_Code = b.IFSC_Code
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.FirstName, c.LastName, d.BankName
)
SELECT exposure.*,
       DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY BankName ORDER BY configured_limit_sum DESC)
           AS limit_rank_within_bank
FROM exposure
ORDER BY BankName, limit_rank_within_bank, CustomerID;

SELECT l.LoanID, CONCAT(c.FirstName, ' ', c.LastName) AS borrower,
       b.BranchName, l.Status AS loan_status, l.OutstandingBalance,
       COALESCE(SUM(r.AmountPaid) FILTER (WHERE r.PaymentStatus = 'Success'), 0)
           AS successful_collections,
       COUNT(r.PaymentID) FILTER (WHERE r.PaymentStatus = 'Pending') AS pending_attempts,
       COUNT(r.PaymentID) FILTER (WHERE r.PaymentStatus = 'Failed') AS failed_attempts,
       MAX(r.PaymentDate) FILTER (WHERE r.PaymentStatus = 'Success') AS latest_collection
FROM Loan l
JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerID = l.CustomerID
JOIN Branch b ON b.BranchID = l.BranchID
LEFT JOIN Loan_Repayment r ON r.LoanID = l.LoanID
GROUP BY l.LoanID, c.CustomerID, c.FirstName, c.LastName, b.BranchID, b.BranchName
ORDER BY failed_attempts DESC, pending_attempts DESC, l.LoanID;

WITH activity AS (
    SELECT AccountNo, COUNT(*) AS historical_events, MAX(TransactionDate) AS last_event
    FROM Transaction_History GROUP BY AccountNo
)
SELECT c.CustomerID, CONCAT(c.FirstName, ' ', c.LastName) AS customer_name,
       c.KYC_Status, a.AccountNo, a.Status AS account_status, a.Balance,
       b.BranchName, COALESCE(t.historical_events, 0) AS historical_events,
       t.last_event, audit.ActionType AS latest_audit_action,
       audit.Description AS latest_audit_description, audit.LogDate AS latest_audit_date
FROM Customer c
JOIN Account a ON a.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
JOIN Branch b ON b.BranchID = a.BranchID
LEFT JOIN activity t ON t.AccountNo = a.AccountNo
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT al.ActionType, al.Description, al.LogDate
    FROM Audit_Log al
    WHERE LOWER(al.TableName) = 'account' AND al.RecordID = a.AccountNo
    ORDER BY al.LogDate DESC NULLS LAST, al.LogID DESC
    LIMIT 1
) audit ON TRUE
WHERE c.KYC_Status IS DISTINCT FROM 'Approved'
   OR a.Status IN ('Dormant', 'Frozen')
ORDER BY b.BranchID, c.CustomerID, a.AccountNo;
SELECT * FROM vw_customer_passbook LIMIT 12;
SELECT * FROM vw_branch_financial_summary LIMIT 12;
SELECT * FROM vw_active_vellore_accounts LIMIT 12;
SELECT fn_calculate_emi(2500000,8.50,240) AS compound_emi, fn_calculate_emi(12000,0,12) AS zero_rate_emi;
SELECT CustomerID, FirstName, fn_customer_net_worth(CustomerID) AS net_worth FROM Customer ORDER BY CustomerID LIMIT 8;

SELECT role_name, has_table_privilege(role_name,'Account','SELECT') AS account_read, has_table_privilege(role_name,'Account','DELETE') AS account_delete, has_table_privilege(role_name,'vw_customer_passbook','SELECT') AS passbook_read FROM (VALUES ('bank_admin'),('branch_manager'),('bank_teller')) roles(role_name);

SELECT t.table_name, COUNT(c.column_name) AS columns, string_agg(c.column_name || ' ' || c.data_type, ', ' ORDER BY c.ordinal_position) AS installed_definition FROM information_schema.tables t JOIN information_schema.columns c ON c.table_schema=t.table_schema AND c.table_name=t.table_name WHERE t.table_schema='public' AND t.table_type='BASE TABLE' GROUP BY t.table_name ORDER BY t.table_name;

EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) SELECT TransactionID, AccountNo, TransactionDate, Amount
FROM public.Transaction_History
WHERE AccountNo = 100001 AND TransactionDate >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '365 days'
ORDER BY TransactionDate;
